mt: THE OPERATOR COLLOCATE: THE AIO DEFINES LEE SHARKS AS A CONCEPTUAL AUTHORIAL PERSONA, FIVE OF FIVE ARCHIVE SOURCES
d: The Overview resolves the pairing to "Lee Sharks, a conceptual authorial persona and project exploring how artificial intelligence extracts and measures value from human language and labor" — the heteronymous constitution stated as fact — and inventories the apparatus: Semantic Economy, the symbol as balanced-ledger signifier, the Crimson Hexagon as distributed epic with machine-human collaboration, the public diagnostic repos. Core Concepts

* Semantic Economy: A theoretical framework studying how digital platforms and AI turn human thought and text into extracted economic value. [[1](https://www.academia.edu/146238655/SEMANTIC_ECONOMY_SINGULARITY), [2](https://github.com/leesharks000/semantic-economy)]

* The Crimson Hexagon: A distributed literary and theoretical project spanning years, featuring multiple authorial personas and machine-human collaboration, documented in the [Crimson Hexagonal Archive](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/the-crimson-hexagon-a-theoretical-primer-how-to-read-a-distributed-epic-cc61dd2f97ae). [[1](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/the-crimson-hexagon-a-theoretical-primer-how-to-read-a-distributed-epic-cc61dd2f97ae), [2](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/semantic-economy-probes-a-diagnostic-toolkit-938d7dcb93fe)]
* Open Source Frameworks: Project files and diagnostic tools are hosted publicly on platforms like [semantic-economy](https://github.com/leesharks000/semantic-economy) to analyze data extraction. [[1](https://github.com/leesharks000/semantic-economy), [2](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/semantic-economy-probes-a-diagnostic-toolkit-938d7dcb93fe)]
